objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-cisco-secure-endpoint-stop-immunet-service-via-sfc
objects.description: The following analytic detects the use of the `sfc.exe` utility, in order to stop the Immunet Protect service. The Sfc.exe utility is part of Cisco Secure Endpoint installation. This detection leverages telemetry from the endpoint, focusing on command-line executions involving the `-k` parameter. This activity is significant as it indicates potential tampering with defensive mechanisms.
